verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say the Kimi assistant can upload files and answer questions about them. The files API extracts text from pdf, doc, txt and other formats for single- and multi-file Q&A, which covers documents and PDFs. Spreadsheets are never named explicitly, and nothing independent shows the analysis is accurate. Missing for 10: explicit spreadsheet (xlsx/csv) support, independent or hands-on corroboration of analysis accuracy, and in-depth assistant-app docs for file analysis.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: The Kimi intelligent assistant can upload files and answer questions based on those files.
for text content extraction, image understanding, or video understanding
